description: CR 101.4/603.3b the active player's trigger is placed first (bottom of stack)
note: Barbarian Outcast's CR 603.8 state trigger needs no event, so one Outcast under each player, neither controlling a Swamp, gives two controllers with one trigger apiece: no ordering prompt, only the APNAP walk. alice is active, so hers goes on the stack first and bob's sits on top.
